#   莫尔=Moore, 雷冬=Leidong, 枫杏红=Feng Xinghong, 左阿=Zuo'a, 纳鹰=Na Ying, 石风雄=Shi Fengxiong.

${f_enemy.name} drained ${format_number(character.stats.full.attack_power * 2.0)} Attack [Sync · Magic]
${f_enemy.name} drained ${format_number(character.stats.full.attack_power * 0.5)} Health [Blade Drain]
${f_enemy.name} drained ${format_number(character.stats.full.defense * 0.5)} Health [Shield Drain]
${f_enemy.name} drained ${format_number(character.stats.full.attack_power * 2.5)} Health [Blade Drain]
${f_enemy.name} drained ${format_number(character.stats.full.defense * 2.5)} Health [Shield Drain]
${f_enemy.name} drained ${format_number(character.stats.full.agility * newEnemy.spec_value[30])} Attack [Purify]

[Crypt Breeder] Oho, someone barged all the way in here?
[Nanami] I won't waste words with you. Speak — why do you want to harm my Na Family!
[Shaxue] (Here we omit 22 well-known plot lines about the Bloodkill Hall and the Crypt Breeder.)
[Nanami] In that case, it's about time… Koko!
A strange weapon suddenly appeared in the girl's hand. About a meter long, with a pitch-black hollow at its tip. Its whole texture radiated a suffocating menace.
In barely a tenth of a second, the weapon in Nanami's hand burst with dazzling silver-white light. With a thunderous boom, the entire Crypt seemed to tremble!
Struck by the recoil, Nanami spat blood. Neko, snapping to her senses, immediately embraced her sister, together bracing against the weapon's staggering kickback.
[Neko] Are you okay, Sis—
[Nanami] Cough… it's not over yet, Koko. What comes next, I leave to you!
The Crypt Breeder, struck head-on, lost half its body almost instantly and let out a venomous roar.
[Crypt Breeder] Argh, what was that, impossible!! Damn it, I fell for it — I'll kill you, kill you all, wipe out every last one of you Yangang Fief people—
[Nanami] Koko, don't let your guard down! This is a Sky-Tier powerhouse's dying flare — just hold out through this and it'll be enough!
[Neko] Understood!
The Crypt Breeder is on its last breath! Its Attack/Defense/Agility/Health are cut to one-hundredth of before!
[Shaxue] High-energy reaction! Detected that Nanami is not in the party!
The Crypt Breeder is now full of vigor! Its Attack/Defense/Agility/Health are all back to their former state!
Because you hold ${key_cnt} Tiny Flower Fragments, aura weakened: 140% -> ${140-key_cnt*8}%!
Because you hold ${key_cnt} Tiny Flower Fragments, aura weakened: 132% -> ${132-key_cnt*8}%!
{"id":"峰"}  [data id reference to 峰=Feng — leave unchanged in source]
[Feng] Finally made it. All that trailing her the whole way wasn't for nothing.
[Feng] Well then, it's about time I got going too…
The Aura Staff blazed with light, then dimmed…
Its materials aren't enough to amplify such a powerful enemy!
[Aura Staff] BOSS-tier enemies can't be amplified!
[Aura Staff] Aura: ${format_number(100*(this.enemy_stat_halo + halo_fix - 0.25))}% -> ${format_number(100*(this.enemy_stat_halo + halo_fix))}%
With a sound like a balloon deflating,
the Wildbeast Puppet was squashed flat by Neko's Skyhigh-Tier intimidation.
For something cobbled together from swamp materials, lasting this long is already impressive…
Summoned 3x Warship Weeder B1
[Defeat Shift] ${E_name} is shielded from the front by ${enemy.name}!
A place forever as dim as a clear night.
A very dark place, darker than most dark nights.
Pure darkness, without even a sliver of light.
A thin intimidation pervades the area, slightly affecting attack potency and speed.
A thick intimidation pervades the area, greatly affecting attack potency and speed.
The Deepwood's venomous insects bite you until you can barely cope…
A bright, tidy hall — where Neko usually spends her time.
A small wooden cabin deep in the Training Ground.
The path ahead seems unguarded... could this be the passage to the outside world?
A cozy little room with a small pink bed and a practice workbench.
Where the Na Family's youngsters train. There are young monsters to spar with.
To save Sister, you must first raise your own strength! Head to the Training Ground and spar with the monsters first.
A bit deeper into the Training Ground. There are young monsters to spar with.
Not enough... don't get smug over beating the weakest monsters — the road is still long!
The depths of the Training Ground. There are growth-stage monsters to spar with.
A dark path within the Training Ground. The growth-stage monsters are a cut stronger.
A dark passage within the Training Ground; the dimness already affects combat.
So dark… so scary… maybe I should forge some armor to protect myself.
Before a dark passage; faint points of light seem to come from its end?
Even a kid could sneak in here, which means this must be the right path! Yay!
No longer dark, but the area near the side gate is swarming with monsters.
Lots of suspicious doors nearby! But to inspect them, you must first defeat the crowd of enemies before you…
Before a heavy door. Looks like getting out means knocking the Attendant out cold…

Halt, miss.
Those below Earth-Tier are forbidden to come and go freely here.
The bustling outer city of Yangang. Even in a world that worships strength, the citizens never run out of things to gossip about.
No matter how many times you see it, the city's splendor turns heads. But right now, getting out of the city as fast as possible is what matters!
An ordinary street on Yangang City's 14th Ring.
An ordinary street on Yangang City's 15th Ring.
A stele inscribed by Yangang's city lord "Shi Fengxiong," recording basic Bloodfall techniques.
Where'd this little girl come from? Want to grasp the techniques here? Get past us first!
An ordinary street on Yangang City's 16th Ring.
An ordinary street on Yangang City's 17th Ring.
From here you can already faintly make out the city gate… Yangang City has 18 Rings in all; beyond that lie the outskirts.
The ring road of Yangang City's outermost Ring.
Yangang City's gate — just defeat the Stone Sprites blocking the way to get out!

Finally at the foot of the city gate...
What IS this granite come to life! Guess I'll just have to defeat it first.
The area outside Yangang City. Birdsong and blossoms, shady green trees — yet a great many Tide-Tier monsters lurk within.
Finally out of the city! Now, let's find someone to ask for some information.
Not far outside the city gate. Looks like it's time to teach that condescending old man a lesson!
Hey mister, isn't it a bit much, a man your age bullying a little girl? Looks like you need a lesson.
Following the treasure map, a monster-filled area on the necessary route.
Following the treasure map, an area where ill-intentioned cultivators lie in ambush.
Following the treasure map, an area with a great many Wildbeasts.
An area with aura-buffed Wildbeasts; the Wildbeasts' overall strength is bumped up a tier.
An area closer to the aura's source, drawing in Earth-Tier powerhouses.
The Crypt looms on the horizon, within reach. But the nearby monsters have grown even more frenzied.
The building before you should be the treasure site. There's someone ahead — that outfit, a Yangang Fief mercenary?
The Crypt's entrance, the source of the frenzied aura. Some possessed mercenaries linger here.
Something's wrong — why do these people look at me with such crazed eyes? Could it be some evil spell?
A bright little river, good for practicing your swimming!
A gathering spot for cultivators around the mine; it has a workbench a bit better than the practice one, a simple rest room, and some leftover A1-tier metal underground!
Shut the doors and windows, sleep for a bit.
Use the shared workbench [Tier+2]
The Crypt's entrance. The scent of gems is strong, but Earth-Tier Rank 3 enemies stand guard.
What a terrifying aura — a monster this scary right inside the door!
Are you sure you want to fight it… taking hits to grow stronger has been nerfed now, you know!
The Crypt's shallow layer. Teeming with Wildbeasts, and hiding many treasures too.
A wide-open "treasure site" littered with Earth-Tier powerhouses.
A Crypt area full of Wildbeasts and frenzied humans; the humans here seem to have become killing machines.
Go back and call the family? That would waste too much time, and Sister would be in danger. No — now isn't the time to think about that.
A Crypt area fraught with danger. Oh, and Crypt Metal is on sale!
A powerhouse once said… opportunity is always something you seize for yourself. Sitting still, waiting for it to fall on your head, isn't realistic.
A sea formed of Wildbeasts; on the stone wall you can find cultivation arts.
Some words are carved on the stone wall. They look like a kind of cultivation art.
The Crypt's 15th floor, the end of the Wildbeast Sea. The path further down is blocked by an Abyssal Shadow.
Earth-Tier Rank 2, and clearly not the just-broke-through kind. Is it the leader of these Wildbeasts?
The Crypt's 13th floor, a stone wall inscribed with cultivation arts. But only by clearing the Wildbeasts will there be time to comprehend them.
The area beyond the Wildbeast Sea. Nanami is trapped here.
What an eerie aura. This doesn't seem like a relic left by a powerhouse — because when powerhouses make relics, they usually leave guidance.
A chaotic corridor, a pungent bloody stench. The environment is a layer worse than the Crypt's shallow layer.
Deeper into the Crypt; in the distance a blue-purple light curtain seems to appear.
An area near the blue-purple light curtain; some floating platforms lie ahead.
The deep area beyond the floating platforms. The Wildbeasts here have generally reached Earth-Tier Rank 3.
A deep area where Wildbeasts are packed in pairs. The source of the violent aura isn't far now…
That's it! Beyond the far shore of the Rank-3 Wildbeast Sea, the culprit behind it all…
Behind the raging rock-fire hides a Superior Yellow Gem. It's exceedingly ferocious, but its life force is like a candle in the wind — snuffed out at a touch.
[Neko] I've got to get it. Hehe, it must be worth a lot — I wonder how much it'll sell for… [Nanami] It wouldn't fetch even a single Red Knife Coin!
The green-purple light curtain is right before your eyes. Instinct tells Neko a place like this must hide something good behind it.
The safe area behind the green-purple light curtain. The curtain itself has a "refining" ability, and can also be used as a workbench.
Use the light curtain to process items [Tier+4]
The deepest part of the Crypt. The 【Crypt Breeder】 is right in the center of this 35th-floor underground chamber.
[Nanami] There's also the aura of a fearsome powerhouse. Koko, we may soon have to face an unbeatable opponent. Until I play my trump card, do not act rashly.
The safe zone for Neko's next training ground after leaving the Crypt.
The interior of the Wildbeast Forest. Dense trees block most of the sunlight, and many Wildbeasts lurk in the dark.
A forest area overrun with Wildbeasts, with many Earth-Tier cultivators who've come to train too.
A forest area overrun with Wildbeasts; some have migrated here from the now treasure-stripped Crypt.
A forest area overrun with Wildbeasts; some possess powerful recovery abilities.
Unlocked Wildbeast Forest - 3. Besides that, felling the camp's willows is now unlocked too.
A forest area overrun with Wildbeasts; some Wildbeasts and humans have reached Earth-Tier Rank 5.
A battle with the Hundred-Clans Guards. Defeat them and you can flee.
[Neko] You're right, but your brother hasn't even reached Earth-Tier — how did you cultivate all the way to Earth-Tier Rank 7?
A battle with Baifang. You can come back and beat him later!
[Baifang] It ran off? This is a problem. Getting another chance to strike won't come so easy.
Head back along this river and you can return to the family… hurry and report this to Father!
Along the Qingye River, the road home. Baifang still has arrangements set up in this area.
Along the Qingye River, the road home. Wildbeasts swarm — to avoid Baifang, a danger zone of this level is unavoidable.
Along the Qingye River, the road home. Not only do Wildbeasts swarm, but there's a faint frenzied aura in this area.
Along the Qingye River, the road home. The Wildbeasts' strength has leapt greatly, but the family is no longer far — no need to linger in battle.
A chance encounter with a Rank-7 warrior; giving it your all still can't win… don't forget this "fly-away" later (x
Near a waterfall Neko visited as a child. It seems to hold some kind of insight.
Father is not far off. Just defeat this menial and you'll be safe!
A training Secret Realm built by the Na Family. It has an advanced workbench, a rest area, and a storage room.
Regulate your breathing, meditate [+10 XP/s]
Use the advanced workbench [Tier+6]
A training Secret Realm built by the Na Family. It has five layers, each with more and stronger Wildbeasts and monsters, and a stronger aura effect.
A training Secret Realm built by the Na Family. This is the outermost area.
A training Secret Realm built by the Na Family. This is a fairly outer area.
A training Secret Realm built by the Na Family. This is the area between inner and outer.
A training Secret Realm built by the Na Family. This is the area fairly close to the core.
A training Secret Realm built by the Na Family. This is the core area.
The innermost area of the Na Family's training Secret Realm. The spirit-array strength can be freely adjusted. (The Levelary may lag; go by the Heart-Fire Elf for stats.)
The Secret Realm's innermost elf is right here. Defeat it to take control of the whole Secret Realm!
The Barrier Lake, which seals the "Spirit," reached under Ancestor Na Ying's guidance.
The lake at the Secret Realm's core. Newborn "Spirits" and Wildbeasts roam here.
The lake at the Secret Realm's core. Newborn "Spirits," humans, and the Secret Realm's guardian coexist.
The lake at the Secret Realm's core. Quite dangerous earthbound "Spirits" have appeared — fall in carelessly and you won't easily escape.
The lake at the Secret Realm's core. More human bodies possessed by "Spirits" have appeared.
Ugh… so strong! I hope you didn't lose your Tiny Flower Fragments.
Before you knew it… you've reached the core area. The "Spirits" living here are first-rate in strength too.
The lord's city of the Shenglü Fief, blasted to ruins by a D9-tier spaceship. Amid the chaos lie many useful treasures.
Shenglü City, destroyed by a D9 spaceship. It's a mixed bag in here — good for fishing in troubled waters.
…one-shot the moment you peek out?! If you can read this line, you've surely already found the way to crack it.

An Earth-Tier Peak Shadow Wildbeast actually blocks the way…
Then I'll use it to test how much I've improved.
The chaotic battlefield outside Shenglü City. No need to linger — the target is the B9 spaceship!
The Rune Workbench Kit even throws in a chest, a bed, and an energy-gathering array! Truly great value…
Cultivate in the Rune House [+40 XP/s]
Use the Rune Workbench [Tier+8]
The battlefield outside Shenglü City, destroyed by a D9 spaceship — killing and plunder are commonplace.
Ahead is the goal of this trip — [the B9 Spaceship]. But there's a big blue robot blocking the way, y'know.
[Shaxue] The core of the 【Scattered Bloom】 insight is weakening attack based on the health ratio. To crack it, simply raise your Health Cap, or deal forced damage.
This blue fellow, with its power and speed… already rivals the Crypt Breeder of that day. You must fully prepare before heading over.
The final goal of the Shenglü City trip. It may hold treasures rare even on the Bloodfall Continent, yet everything about it exudes hostility and murderous cold toward outsiders.
The interior of the B9-tier spaceship. Some suppression field makes outsiders quite uncomfortable.
The interior of the B9-tier spaceship. Some heavy-industry machines that seem to share an origin have appeared.
The interior of the B9-tier spaceship. There seems to be a mole mixed in!
The interior of the B9-tier spaceship. The biggest enemies are all at -5…
The interior of the B9-tier spaceship. Watch out for the 416-416-416 Black-Iron Warriors!
Wait — if my eyes aren't deceiving me, that fellow in the upper right is…!
Hmph, young master Baifang? What a small world. Running into you here… it's time to make you pay!
There are Sky-Tier robots blocking the way here! But the gem behind them looks pretty huge…
Legend says past here is the spaceship adventurers' exchange meet… gotta think of a way to beat that blue fellow!
Too much plot, won't write it here for now… come to think of it, memory's so expensive, this Storage Maiden B1 must be worth a fortune.
Coo! Coo coo!
The core part of the Alien Spaceship. Intimidation pervades it, yet it holds the opportunity to reach Sky-Tier.
We must have entered the core region; the road ahead is likely littered with powerful technological creations.
The core of the B9-tier spaceship. The suppression field is stronger, and B1-tier machines are everywhere.
The core of the B9-tier spaceship. The suppression field is stronger. Experience resisting it accumulates faster and faster.
The core of the B9-tier spaceship. Machines and Wildbeasts coexist; you can catch the faint scent of evolution crystals.
The core of the B9-tier spaceship. Machines and Wildbeasts coexist; a dangerous aura is not far off.
This is the place! Charge through! No need to linger — it's all B1-tier specialized machines even more terrifying than B2!
Two mechanical creations seem to be guarding some kind of cultivation art.
A room behind the red door, thick with the aura of evolution. It seems someone ran experiments here.
[Nanami] Do you feel it, Koko? The nearby energy is a little restless, as if swirling around some center.
Those who didn't buy the Rune Workbench before are in luck! Alien tech — both its energy-gathering array and workbench are a tier better than the Rune House's.
Use the alien energy-gathering array [+120 XP/s]
Use the alien workbench [Tier+10]
Alert! Alert! Unidentified life-forms have reached the core area! Activating main combat hub, executing emergency purge program—
The outer edge of a beast-tide spread zone, after the Alien Spaceship triggered the 【Beast Tide】.
Two years later, Yangang Fief, Hull Swamp.
A Sky-Tier Wildbeast gathering ground in a beast-tide spread zone, after the Alien Spaceship triggered the 【Beast Tide】.
A swamp swept by the 【Beast Tide】. The beast kings above Skyhigh-Tier have been wiped out, but early Sky-Tier Wildbeasts are still quite common.
The elite Yangang mercenaries took Baifang's commission and lured Neko here. Yet behind danger may lie opportunity.
[Yangang Elite Mercenary x2] Monster… stay back!
A dark, cloud-shrouded forest. Neko has lost her way here, and there seems to be no one around.
In novels, a creepy place like this always has bad things happen, right? Ugh… I have to be careful from here, and slowly find my way back.
A dark, cloud-shrouded forest. But everyone's Night Vision skill should be maxed long ago, right?
A dark, cloud-shrouded forest. An ominous aura all around.
A dark, cloud-shrouded forest. The enemies' life force is a cut higher.
A dark, cloud-shrouded forest. With Brother Feng's guidance, the exit is right ahead.
There's a huge Savage-Gu Beast near the young man eating grilled meat! Hurry and save him!
Huh, someone's ahead?
Brother Feng's Moonwheel insight, free for a limited time! Just blast this Ferocious Beast!
[Leidong] Ahead is a mutated Wildbeast, likely at the Rank-4 Peak level.
A one-stop solution of shop-sleep-chest-crafting. Truly the best inn in the city — it feels like home.
Rest at Feiyun Pavilion [+360 XP/s]
Go to the Refining Tower to craft [Tier+12]
A rather frigid land of ice and snow. The temperature lingers around 240K (-33°C), and the ice element in the air can even bring misfortune upon Earth-Tier cultivators.
In a silver-white world wrapped in thick snow, two girls stand atop a snow-mountain peak, overlooking the boundless white land.
A white world of ice and snow. The ice element makes some ice-element insights easy to cast — be careful!
Be sure to always keep your health line in a healthy range. Once it drops out, Ice Seal's combo…
Ice Seal has levels too! It's fine if the one that blocked the last zone ≠ the next zone's…
By rights there should be a 1.3e8-defense Scattered Bloom here. But without a Magic Attack potion right now, I can only take it and go.
Ahead is a stone gate flanked by ice and snow. You must get past this grudge-monster to touch it.
System hint: touching the Frost Portal may bring an unexpected reward.
[Hunter-Soldier] Nothing more to say — if you really want to apologize, then stay here! Kill!
So sorry, the last character of this place's name has been changed… to keep a cat from falling into the void, this location was made!
Set in the heart of the Pure White Ice Field, a city made entirely of Ice Blocks. The witches seem to want to keep Neko and Nanami here, without realizing the tables have quietly turned.
[Witch] Little outsiders, I thought you'd back off knowing the odds, but you actually barged into this ice city.
An ice-block city brimming with hostility, where witches guide the frenzied Wildbeasts.
An ice-block city brimming with hostility, where more witches keep unleashing aura on the Wildbeasts.
An ice-block city brimming with hostility; the witches have left… after all, even they can't control the power of the Ice-Blood Weeders.
An ice-block city brimming with hostility. This is a more central area… the strange pink-haired girl seems to be nearby! Should you follow?
Under the aura's protection, we shall charge to the death! Aaaaaahhh!!!
[Hostile Old Man] Arrogant outsider, killing my kinsmen — your crime deserves death!
A strange domain brimming with the water element. You came in after being knocked out by that strange pink-haired girl!
[Old Man] You lot… are finished… the master will… avenge us…
This zone has quite a lot of mini-bosses. They'll be split from I to IV!
Moore has a good temper, and is a good person too… there won't be a "kill" button.
A water prison imprisoning many Sky-Tier powerhouses. It also breeds many 【Spirits】 used to accumulate XP.
A grotto "voluntarily" vacated by a ranking powerhouse after hearing of the Neko sisters' feats.
Cultivate in the Water Prison Grotto [+1440 XP/s]
Use the smelting array [Tier+14]
A strange domain brimming with the water element. Set out from here to challenge the ranking powerhouses!
A water prison imprisoning many Sky-Tier powerhouses. From here you can head to the ranking powerhouses' quarters.
A water prison imprisoning many Sky-Tier powerhouses. The shore is getting closer and closer.
Defeat her to unlock Time-Sealed Water Prison - 5!
Defeat her to… get three Legendary Red Gems?
Defeat her to leave the Water Prison!
You've left the Time-Sealed Water Prison's range… wait! That pink-haired girl!
A space radiating multicolored light, surrounded by many Wildbeasts of (roughly?) equal strength. Awakened — it's hunting time!
A space radiating multicolored light. Whatever Zuo'a is really after, at least there truly are many breakthrough opportunities here.
Defeat the come-to-life Bestiary to obtain the five-colored crystals — and Starmirror Violet too, of course.
Let's test whether the damage is normal! (It's definitely NOT because Shaxue's save is stuck at 3-5 and can't test that this map got put here.)
If you can't win, go back and eat a couple Restraint books! Maybe there are other cheese strats too?
The journey through the illusion should end here… wait, you're kidding, this — this is the Crypt? I hear Sister's voice!
Faintly hear Sister's voice?! Sister couldn't be — right there —
Bold Furball! One look and I can tell you're not Sister! Sister can go Ethereal, sure, but she's nowhere near as strong as you.
So this time it's — the Family Secret Realm, the Barrier Lake? I wonder if there are Icicle Fish here. This place, too, is… somewhere that deeply shaped me.
It was right here that Senior Na Ying taught me so much cultivation wisdom, helping me grow step by step to where I am now.
The illusion has been broken through two layers now. That catastrophe of devastation… being there in person, one can't help turning violent.
You must firmly believe — all this catastrophe… is an illusion… an illusion!
By the way, what clever uses might a Penrose triangle have in offense and defense? Feels like a nice theme for a bit of ingenuity.
So then, the fourth-layer illusion… the alien visitors' Spaceship Core? Come to think of it, a strange resentment seems to be gathering nearby.
This resentment… it wasn't sensed in any of the previous three illusion layers. This time, what is it?
Looks like talking won't work! Plan B~ Phys·i·cal De·liv·er·ance!
Really vicious! Savage-Gu Beast, Fierce-Gu Beast, Terror-Gu Beast — taking name suggestions for the next one! How about Rampage-Gu Beast?
What thick fog… but making out what's in front is still no problem. This is the forest where I met Brother Feng, right?
Come to think of it, if the Hundred Clans hadn't schemed with many factions, I'd never have met Brother Feng, and none of what followed would have happened.
This fellow's confidence depends on how deeply it's poisoned by Restraint! In the end it's just a factor of two… don't blame Restraint when your Magic Attack falls short.

After breaking free from the Inner Demon's assault, colorful light emerges. All five illusion layers shatter; this place is the true core of the illusion. Also, Zuo'a is busy erasing marks, so you can sneak a use of the array here!
Borrow the illusion array to cultivate [+5760 XP/s]
Borrow the smelting array [Tier+16]
Please step onto the final battleground and defeat Zuo'a!
This is the ultimate end of Act 3! Oh, and you can't go back. Revival is on-the-spot revival too.
Heart Spirit · Confinement — choose-your-own enemy area!
Heart Spirit · Proliferation — choose-your-own enemy area!
Heart Spirit · Rampage — choose-your-own enemy area!
Zuo'a's final battle!
Zuo'a's battle… is over!
Finally back at the family! Time to seize the head-of-house seat…
The old man broke through. Taking the treasure won't be as simple as in the original story!
The thrilling Yangang Fief Hunting Tournament. This is the first stage!
The tense, exciting Yangang Fief Hunting Tournament~ all Skyhigh-Tier combatants~
I hear many powerhouses nearby have chosen to band together for warmth. Without enough influence, even buying supplies might be a problem?
A lone hero valiantly slaying enemies can't expand a whole faction's influence. What truly matters is a mass of mainstays…
[Neko] Huh, that person over there looks lifeless. Are they already dead and eliminated… wait! Why did it turn green and get stronger! I must avoid it.
I've come back from hell! Do you know how I've spent these past few decades?!!
The Barrier Lake boss fight makes a triumphant return! Still the mage-warrior-tank lineup~
Seemingly an ancient battlefield abandoned in a past epoch. Traces of artificial constructs remain, yet the vegetation has grown wildly lush.

[Neko] Odd — no route map for the Hunting Tournament seems to have been handed out before the battle. But since it's a hunt, following the route with the most powerhouses and Wildbeasts is the right call!

A wild supply area. It seems the aura of an ancient forging furnace drove off the venomous insects here, making it a rare haven in the Deepwood. There's even some water here, good for practicing high-difficulty swimming moves!
Cultivate resources at the supply point [+23040 XP/s]
Use the ancient forging furnace left by predecessors [Tier+18]
Because of the many powerhouse corpses on the ancient battlefield, the mosquitoes have gradually adapted and evolved, greatly boosting their armor-piercing power!
[???] Buzz buzz buzz buzz… [Neko] Looks like this route is thick with mosquitoes. Until I have a strong recovery effect, better to end fights as fast as possible.
The Weird Old Tree really is the number-one mountain pass under heaven. Good news: 4-3 doesn't have this thing.

[Neko] As I push deeper into the Deepwood, the enemies grow stronger, yet the mosquito count — which indicates heaven-and-earth energy density — stays nearly constant. There must be an entrance to a great opportunity ahead!
Counter-cards aren't only Neko's items: see, that 【Harden】 is the counter-card for the C1 Laser Gun · Damaged.
There are no Weird Old Trees here anymore. But the price is… ultimate stats and mechanics!
[Neko] The powerhouses all seem gathered before an impregnable main gate. To go around it, just quickly defeat 3 sentries! Great chance!
Hurry and take them all out! They don't look like they have much health, but these are all Time-Seals…

Knew there'd be good stuff in front of the sentry post~ Though the ancient tomb reeks of a cold, gloomy aura, you can faintly sense that breaking through to Skyhigh-Tier is right here! [Endpoint of pre-V4.20 versions]
